content: Yesu nêêl nambe navu biing Vavi Vaambuung naam
+ o 1:1 Luk 1:1-4*O Tiopilas, vakasin sen sa kaavu neep munggin-ato

Luk 1:1-4* ond gale gangge naambe Luk kaavu banye nivasaa-ju la vu Tiopilas, om yik Luk-anju sen kaavu sinaale-sote kaapiyaa-jo having. ond sa kaavu lak va pin sen Yesu wiing osin tatekin tanasin vu hil-ato,

+ o 1:2 Mak 16:19; Luk 24:49-51*vu munggin-ambe hato busin sen Anutu hako yi laah baandonii-to. Ond naahen nando voon-ande vu kul vu yite sinaale-so sen bôôy holin sil-ato, ond vu kul lak Vavi Vaambuung-ate niwêêk.

+ o 1:3 Luk 24:36-49; Sin 10:41*Bôôy hako nivaane be yimb, de kandi lak atombe nando voon lohvu busin doo-yuuh, be navu taato yi vu yite sinaale-so in nambe lanjak ni naambe nando metumin, tombe nêêl vakasin sen Anutu nanggin yite hil-ato vu sil.

+ o 1:4 Luk 24:49; Jon 14:16-17; Sin 2:33*De yoo naahen nando having sil-ato ond nêêlin sil nambe, “Ham-ame gavuuh Yelusalem e, ham oo mando ganggin va sen saanêêl vu ham bôôy nambe Aamangg nêêl nambe le bu naam-ato.
+ o 1:5 Mat 3:11*De Jon lipis hil-ato ond lipis sil lak bel, de ngaaho lak in Anutu navu biing Vavi Vaambuung naas mando gaving ham.”
+ o 1:6 Luk 24:21*Tombe sinaale-so lasupin dando lavuh ti le mem lalingin yi nambe, “Omaaho Bop, mak peey e onavu gambiing-ambe yiiy Islel oo ganggin yiiy naah a?”
+ o 1:7 Mak 13:32*Le nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham-ame hamate va in nambe ham anjak ta osin busin sen Mangg oo hatung-ato ni le, yik Mangg timu yoo nanggin vaa-jo.

+ o 1:8 Mat 28:19; Luk 24:48; Sin 2:32; 3:15; 5:32; Ep 3:16*Lemu Vavi Vaambuung e jakana ham-ambe bu niwêêk vu ham, tombe mem ham e naanêêl sa haalengg vu Yelusalem de vu Yudia pin osin vu Samaalia be na nohvu taaku nanyendangga pin.”
Yesu lakalaah baandoni
+ o 1:9 Jon 6:62*Yesu nêêl vakasin-anjo lung la, tonde layi de valu-nala baandoni, tombe bayiimb ti hako yi be la, tonde me-layi yi yesin laah e.
+ o 1:10 Luk 24:4*Naahen nalak-ande sil oo mondalaah mend ak in, tombe omaaho yuuh lato daale having sil pavis, ond yuuh lalop lolop anivalôôy,

+ o 1:11 Mat 26:64; Luk 21:27; Taato 1:7*tonde yuuh lanêêl nambe, “Ham Galili, nambe vaati sen ham naale mem nangget baandoni? Yesuu-ju sen Anutu vu vêêl in ham-ande hako be la baandoni, ond yik le nom naambe sen ham ahe la baandoni gêên-anju.”
Laholin Matias lukalaah Yudas ahembaan
+ o 1:12 Luk 24:50-53*Sil vu kandu Oliv-ambe lalaah Yelusalem. Kanduu-ju ngaaho daka vu Yelusalem lohvu 1 kilomita mu.

+ o 1:13 Mat 10:2-4*Lala lato Yelusalem-ambe lalakala bayêên alopayo baandoni ti sen sil oo dando hôôk-ato. Hil-anju ond Pita yuuh Jon, de Jems ayuuh Endru, de Pilip ayuuh Tomas, de Batolomai yuuh Matai, de Jems sen Alpias noow-ato yuuh Simon sen naanjiihin hil Yuda in nambe gatiiy hil Lom lanaa-to, de Yudas sen Jems noow-ato.
+ o 1:14 Jon 7:5*Hil-anju pin laving vêêh heey, de Malia sen Yesu tangganaan-ato osin Yesu halindin, ond sil alondpayo lavuh ti de mondalohak dando.
De busin ti tombe hil 120 dando lavuh ti, tombe Pita kandi naale hôôk sil amend-ambe nêêl nambe,
+ o 1:16 Saam 41:9*“Halingg-aso-e, bôôy ond Vavi Vaambuung wiing-ambe Devit nêêl vakasin munggin lak Yudas sen gêên taato mopaatôôv vu hil-ambe lalôôh Yesuu-to, ond vakasin-anjo nôôn ak lung la.
Yudas-anju ond hey ti sen hey ahondoos naawiing kul timuu-to,
+ o 1:18 Mat 27:3-10*tombe mone sen hako lak yite nipayaa-to lala laanggo ngaanggis ti lak, ond Yudas-anju lupake be ninaavi vapuuh-ande ahe kaasêêh.
Tombe hil pin vu Yelusalem langoyin-ambe lanêêl taaku tii-ju hôôk sil lavand nambe Akeldama, dangga nambe ngaanggis ngaamong nihees-ate.
+ o 1:20 Saam 69:25; 109:8*Vakasin-anjo neep hôôk kaapiya Saam nambe,

content.text: de omaaho ti me-le mando jak e.’

content: De Saam ango nêêl nambe,
Om hil sen hey ahondoos having Omaaho Bop Yesu hey ala de aalom, de sil dando having hey lôôt,

+ o 1:22 Jon 15:27*vu busin sen Jon lipis hil-ambe tok laam busin sen Anutu hako Yesu laah in yiiy-ato, ond hil-anja ti kandi jak gaving hey in naanêêl Yesu-te vakasin sen kandi lak-ato langaah gaving e.”
Pita nêêl nambêênju tombe sil lanêêl omaaho yuuh haalend, ango Yusep sen danêêl nambe Basabas, de haale ango nambe Jastas, ond yuuh Matias.
+ o 1:24 Jon 2:25*Tonde lalohak nambe, “Omaaho Bop, goo galak hil pin alondpayo ni, om otaato naambe gaholin omaaho yuuh-anjo ango tana
in nambe gako kul sinaale sen Yudas havuuh neep-ande la valok-atêêto.”
Lalohak lung la tonde sil kaavu yuuh haalend ak tatuuh-ande sil kalo, tombe Matias-ate tatuuh kalov hato sil amend, om lawiing Matias la having sinaale-so nomaayuuh-ambe laam tii-to.
